description: What will you create in the cardboard sculpture challenge? Anything you can imagine! Learn different 3D sculpture techniques using cardboard, wire, string, and other recycled art materials. Draw inspiration from contemporary artists. Design and create an original sculpture inspired by your creative interests.

Can you and your team of robotics engineers design, build, compete and win in the VSA Robo Olympics? Test your skills, communication, teamwork and problem solving through challenges of speed, agility and 1-on-1 battles. A fun-packed day that will hone your engineering, art and interpersonal competencies. Can you be the champion?
staff: Andrew Chiu, Ko Wong, Louis Wong

description: Get ready to blast off! During this exciting hands-on camp, students will design, build, and launch their very own bottle rockets while exploring the science that makes them soar. From testing pressure and air resistance to refining flight stability, each team will apply creativity and problem-solving to engineer the ultimate rocket. The week will finish with the Bottle Rocket Championship!

Work with your team to try to solve the challenging mystery of what happened to Mr. Arnold West whose body was found in Hong Kong's "Boba Tea Booth" on Wellington Street, Central! Apply your reading, writing, and viewing skills to examine the reconstructed crime scene for clues and evidence. Who was involved, and what were their motives?
